executionMappings.scope: DllImport and LibraryImport: exact high-bit UInt64 and mixed scalar signatures, typed aggregate pointer input/output, reverse callbacks and closed-context rejection; separate trimmed MonoWasm and AOT consumers. FunctionTable must fail before replacing published output.

constraints: The external consuming project registers and links native object/archive references with the import identity required by generated bindings; BGCS emits source only.
LibraryImport uses the explicitly resolved browser default Cdecl convention profile.
The browser profile rejects FunctionTable because a native address does not establish trimmed Mono interpreter signature cookies; consumer AOT options do not change generation admission.
Chromium evidence does not certify Firefox or Safari.

responsibilityBoundary: BGCS resolves target facts, parses and generates sources. ManagedCompiled, NativeLinked and Invoked describe independent repository consumer tests; Packaged describes BGCS product installation. They are not product build, link or native asset packaging services.

runtimeProfilesMeaning: Explicit implemented extension identities. Target descriptors, parsed facts and physical resources do not certify a managed execution model or application runtime.
